title: Facebook ads stopped working? Find the cause, then fix it
seoTitle: Facebook ads stopped working? What to check
description: Facebook ads stopped working? Check tracking, offer, audience, fatigue, frequency, budget and learning in order. Get what to look at and what to fix first.
lede: If your Facebook ads stopped working, something changed, and a fixed order of checks usually identifies it. Check tracking, your offer and landing page, the audience, a tired ad, frequency, budget edits and the learning phase. This guide shows where to look in Ads Manager for each one and which fix to make first.
keywords: why did my ads stop converting
